describe.description: The creature is a slender, donkey-like equine shown in strict right-facing profile against a plain off-white background. Its body is elongated with a slightly arched back and a pale, lightly haired underbelly, covered in short brown to gray-brown fur that is darker along the back, neck and outer legs and lighter on the muzzle and inner thighs. The head is held forward on a moderately long neck, the ears are large and upright, the mane is short and bristly, and the tail is thin with a tufted tip hanging behind the hindquarters. All four slender legs end in hooves and support the animal in a standing pose, with no other bodies, wings, or appendages visible.
